title: Meta's AI agent has been blocked from using Amazon.com | TechCrunch
summary: Sunday night, users of Meta’s AI assistant Muse started getting a strange error message when they tried to buy goods on Amazon. Muse has one of the lower hallucination rates , as AI models go, but it’s still pretty far from zero.
